title: Gekka Mugentan Torico
overview:
The city of the moon...... When one who has set foot in that city tries to return to the world of the living, a crest is drawn upon their forehead and all of their memories are taken away......

An otherworldly city where human hopes and desires intertwine...... A world of mystery and fantasy adventure, brought to life with high-quality CG and events that probe the human psyche.

月の街……。
その街へ足を踏み入れし者は現世に戻らんとする時その額には紋章が描かれ一切の記憶を奪われる……。

人間たちの希望と欲望が交錯するこの世ならざる街……。
ハイクオリティCGと人間の心理に迫るイベントがリアルに演出する、神秘と幻想のアドベンチャーの世界。
